title: A Rug from Mom
lines: Ron got a red rug from Mom.
"It can be a bed," he said.
Ron set the rug in the hut.
His pup ran in and sat on it.
But a hen ran in and got on it!
The pup did not run at the hen.
The hen and the pup had a nap.
"The rug from Mom can fit us," said Ron.

questions.listenFor: Mom. The story says it twice. If your child is unsure, point to the word Mom and read that line again.

questions.ask: Who ended up napping on the rug?
questions.listenFor: The hen and the pup, together. Listen for both animals - the pup did not run the hen off.

questions.ask: Do you think the pup was kind to the hen? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason from the story, like the pup let the hen stay, or the rug was big enough for two.
